name: incremental-graph
body: Feature incremental-graph (win C). On very large graphs the DB build (parquet + copy_from + schema) is no longer negligible — it can dominate the scan. The ingestor must seed/splice the DB from the previous one instead of rebuilding it from scratch, while allowing a global projection pass over cached + re-emitted facts that never requires re-running the frontends. A localized re-scan must not perform a full DB rebuild. Acceptance is self-contained (requirements.requirement.incremental-acceptance-targets), measured on synthetic scratch fixtures; this is the part that must not be skipped on huge graphs.
